name: assetpanda/pricing-calculator
title: AP Pricing Calculator
description: Interactive ROI calculator card: range sliders (people, hourly cost, tracked asset value, weekly manual hours) beside an annual-return panel with a gradient total, a three-row breakdown, an ROI note and a button, plus a centred sales line below. Live: `.ap-roi-calculator-section` on /new-pricing/. Stands alone (no dependency on the pricing hero); every number, rate and label is a prop and behaviour.js recomputes on input. Model: hours saved = round(hours/wk x weeks x time_saved_pct% x people / people_baseline); labour = round(hours saved x hourly); loss prevented = round(asset value x loss_pct%); total = labour + loss prevented. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
